examples.en: He's really into photography — his weekends are all photo walks.
examples.zh: 他特别喜欢摄影，周末全是出去拍照。

situation.en: Lately I'm into board games — we play every Friday night.
situation.zh: 你想跟新朋友聊聊你最近沉迷的东西。

examples.en: I play the guitar a bit, mostly old rock songs.
examples.zh: 我会弹一点吉他，主要是老摇滚。

situation.en: I play the guitar, but I'm still a beginner, honestly.
situation.zh: 别人问你有什么爱好，你想说你弹吉他但水平一般。

examples.en: We go hiking in the hills west of the city most weekends.
examples.zh: 大多数周末我们去城西的山里徒步。

situation.en: The weather looks great — let's go hiking on Saturday.
situation.zh: 你邀请朋友这周末一起去爬山。

examples.en: Friday is board game night at my place.
examples.zh: 周五是我家的桌游之夜。

situation.en: Board game night this Friday — who's in?
situation.zh: 你组织朋友来家里玩桌游，在群里喊人。

examples.en: We're planning a road trip along the coast next month.
examples.zh: 我们计划下个月沿海岸来一次自驾游。

situation.en: For the road trip, let's split the driving — four hours each.
situation.zh: 你跟朋友商量假期自驾的路线。

examples.en: Camping by the lake means mosquitoes, but the stars are worth it.
examples.zh: 在湖边露营少不了蚊子，但那片星空值得。

situation.en: Pack bug spray if we're camping near water.
situation.zh: 你劝朋友露营别被蚊子吓退。

examples.en: My dad taught me fishing on this very pier.
examples.zh: 我爸就是在这个码头上教我钓鱼的。

situation.en: I go fishing early on Sundays — it's my quiet time.
situation.zh: 你跟同事聊起你周末的固定节目。

examples.en: We really should catch up — coffee next week?
examples.zh: 我们真该聚聚聊聊近况——下周喝杯咖啡？

situation.en: Let's grab lunch and catch up properly.
situation.zh: 你碰到好久没见的老朋友，提议找时间细聊。

examples.en: Long time no see! You look exactly the same.
examples.zh: 好久不见！你一点都没变。

situation.en: Hey, long time no see — how have you been?
situation.zh: 你在同学聚会上见到五年没见的老同学，第一句说什么？

examples.en: What's new with you? Still at the same company?
examples.zh: 你最近怎么样？还在原来那家公司吗？

situation.en: So, what's new with you these days?
situation.zh: 电话里跟老朋友寒暄，想引出对方的近况。

entries.zh: 你最近怎么样、有什么新鲜事

examples.en: I go for a run before work when the air is still cool.
examples.zh: 趁早上空气还凉，我上班前去跑一圈。

situation.en: Want to go for a run tomorrow at seven?
situation.zh: 你想约同事明早一起晨跑。

examples.en: I hit the gym three times a week after work.
examples.zh: 我每周下班后去三次健身房。

situation.en: No secret — I just hit the gym and sleep enough.
situation.zh: 朋友问你怎么保持状态，你说你规律健身。

examples.en: Do a quick warm-up before you run, or your knees will complain.
examples.zh: 跑步前快速热个身，不然膝盖会抗议。

situation.en: Five minutes of warm-up saves you from most injuries.
situation.zh: 你提醒第一次跑步的朋友别直接开跑。

examples.en: Cool down with a slow walk after a hard session.
examples.zh: 高强度练完后慢走一会儿来放松。

situation.en: Let's cool down and stretch before we head out.
situation.zh: 教练在课尾提醒大家别直接坐下。

examples.en: Stretch for ten minutes after every workout.
examples.zh: 每次练完拉伸十分钟。

situation.en: Since I stretch properly, I'm barely sore the next day.
situation.zh: 你跟健身搭子说你最近拉伸跟上了，酸痛少很多。

examples.en: Sore muscles after leg day make stairs an adventure.
examples.zh: 练完腿第二天肌肉酸痛，下楼梯跟探险一样。

situation.en: I've got sore muscles everywhere — yesterday was leg day.
situation.zh: 你昨天练太狠，今天跟同事吐槽。

examples.en: I registered for the city marathon in October.
examples.zh: 我报名了十月的城市马拉松。

situation.en: Registration closes Friday — register for the race today if you're in.
situation.zh: 你想拉朋友一起报名半马。

examples.en: My gym membership includes all the classes.
examples.zh: 我的健身房会员包含所有团课。

situation.en: A gym membership here costs less than a coffee a day.
situation.zh: 你在比较两家健身房的年卡划不划算。

examples.en: A personal trainer fixed my squat form in one session.
examples.zh: 私教一节课就纠正了我的深蹲姿势。

situation.en: Book a personal trainer for the first month — form first, weights later.
situation.zh: 你建议新手朋友先上几节私教课打基础。

examples.en: Book a flight early — prices jump in the last two weeks.
examples.zh: 机票要早订，最后两周价格会猛涨。

situation.en: I booked a flight for Friday evening, right after work.
situation.zh: 你提醒要出差的同事赶紧订票。

examples.en: I always pick a window seat so I can watch the clouds.
examples.zh: 我总是选考窗的座位，就为了看云。

situation.en: A window seat, please, if there's one left.
situation.zh: 值机时你想跟工作人员说你要靠窗。

examples.en: With a tight connection, an aisle seat gets you off the plane faster.
examples.zh: 转机时间紧的话，靠过道的座位能让你下飞机快一点。

situation.en: I take the aisle seat — I like being able to get up freely.
situation.zh: 你跟朋友解释为什么你长途也选过道位。

examples.en: You can check in online twenty-four hours before the flight.
examples.zh: 航班起飞前二十四小时就能在线值机。

situation.en: Check in tonight so we get seats together.
situation.zh: 你提醒同行的人别忘了提前值机选座。

entries.zh: 办理登机手续；办理入住

examples.en: Keep your boarding pass and ID ready at security.
examples.zh: 过安检时把登机牌和证件准备好。

situation.en: My boarding pass is on my phone — the app has it.
situation.zh: 你在机场提醒爸妈把登机牌收好。

examples.en: For a two-day trip, a carry-on is all I need.
examples.zh: 两天的行程，一个登机箱就够了。

situation.en: Just pack a carry-on — we'll be moving around a lot.
situation.zh: 你劝朋友轻装出行，别托运等行李。

examples.en: We have a three-hour layover in Seoul.
examples.zh: 我们在首尔中转停留三小时。

situation.en: A one-hour layover is too tight for an international connection.
situation.zh: 你看行程单，想确认中转时间够不够。

examples.en: Jet lag hit me hard — I was awake at three every morning.
examples.zh: 时差把我折腾惨了，每天凌晨三点就醒。

situation.en: Give me a day to get over the jet lag, then I'm back.
situation.zh: 你出差回来跟同事说时差还没倒过来。

entries.zh: 时差反应、倒时差的不适

examples.en: Ask at the front desk if you need a later checkout.
examples.zh: 想延迟退房就去前台问。

situation.en: The front desk can call us a taxi for the airport.
situation.zh: 你在酒店想多睡会儿，让同伴去前台问问。

examples.en: We asked for a late checkout since our flight is in the evening.
examples.zh: 我们的航班是晚上的，所以申请了延迟退房。

situation.en: Could we get a late checkout, say two o'clock?
situation.zh: 你打电话给前台想延迟到两点退房。

examples.en: I'd like to extend my stay by one night, if the room is free.
examples.zh: 如果房间还空着，我想再续住一晚。

situation.en: Extending my stay was easy — the front desk handled it in a minute.
situation.zh: 行程变了，你去前台办理续住。

examples.en: Too tired to go out, we ordered room service.
examples.zh: 累得不想出门，我们叫了客房送餐。

situation.en: Room service stops at ten, so order before then.
situation.zh: 你跟朋友说今晚就在房间里解决晚饭。

examples.en: We spent the first day sightseeing and the second just relaxing.
examples.zh: 第一天我们到处观光，第二天就纯放松。

situation.en: One day of sightseeing is enough for me — I prefer slow mornings.
situation.zh: 你跟同事分享你的旅行安排。

examples.en: I always buy one small souvenir — a fridge magnet.
examples.zh: 我每次只买一个小纪念品——一个冰箱贴。

situation.en: These keychains are souvenirs for my team.
situation.zh: 你在机场被朋友问起给家人带了什么。

examples.en: Let's make plans for the long weekend before everything books up.
examples.zh: 长周末的安排得趁早定下来，不然什么都订满了。

situation.en: We keep saying 'soon' — let's actually make plans this time.
situation.zh: 你在群里催大家赶紧把行程定下来。

entries.zh: 定计划、把（聚会、出行）约起来

examples.en: Are you free this weekend? A few of us are going to the lake.
examples.zh: 你这周末有空吗？我们几个想去湖边。

situation.en: Quick question — are you free this weekend?
situation.zh: 你想约朋友周末一起出去玩，第一句怎么问？

examples.en: I'll take a rain check on dinner tonight — deadline week at work.
examples.zh: 今晚的饭我先欠着——这周工作赶截止日期。

situation.en: Can I take a rain check? Next week is much better for me.
situation.zh: 你想婉拒今晚的邀约但表示下次一定。

examples.en: Sorry, I can't make it on Friday — family stuff.
examples.zh: 抱歉，我周五去不了——家里有事。

situation.en: I can't make it this time, but count me in for the next one.
situation.zh: 你要在群里说明你参加不了这次聚餐。

examples.en: I'm running late — the meeting before ran over.
examples.zh: 我要迟到了——前一个会拖堂了。

situation.en: Start without me, I'm running late by about ten minutes.
situation.zh: 你堵在路上，给等你的朋友发消息。

examples.en: Save me a seat near the middle, I'll be there in five.
examples.zh: 帮我占个中间的座位，我五分钟到。

situation.en: Could you save me a seat? The train is just pulling in.
situation.zh: 你让先到的朋友帮你留个位子。

examples.en: You drove all the way — lunch is my treat.
examples.zh: 你大老远开车过来，午饭我请。

situation.en: Put your wallet away — it's my treat today.
situation.zh: 你想请帮你搬家的朋友吃饭表示感谢。

examples.en: We usually go Dutch on team lunches.
examples.zh: 团队午餐我们一般各付各的。

situation.en: Let's go Dutch — it's easier with a group this size.
situation.zh: 一群人吃饭结账时，你提议各付各的。

entries.zh: 各付各的、AA 制（口语说法）

examples.en: They're having a housewarming on Saturday for the new flat.
examples.zh: 他们周六为新房办乔迁聚会。

situation.en: For the housewarming, let's bring a plant instead of wine.
situation.zh: 你收到朋友暖房派对的邀请，跟伴侣商量带什么去。

examples.en: You don't need to bring anything, but a bottle is always safe.
examples.zh: 你什么都不用带，不过带一瓶酒总是不会错的。

situation.en: I'll bring a bottle and that cheesecake you liked.
situation.zh: 你第一次去朋友家吃饭，问另一个朋友该带什么。

examples.en: Please RSVP by Friday so we can order enough food.
examples.zh: 请周五前回复确认出席，我们好订够餐食。

situation.en: The invitation says RSVP — they need a headcount for the room.
situation.zh: 你在给聚会邀请写说明，让大家确认人数。

entries.zh: 请回复（邀请上要求确认出席）

examples.en: The invitation includes a plus-one, so bring your partner.
examples.zh: 邀请里包含一个携伴名额，把你伴侣带来吧。

situation.en: Can I bring a plus-one to the company dinner?
situation.zh: 你想确认婚礼能不能带上女朋友一起去。

entries.zh: （参加活动时）可额外携带的一位同伴

examples.en: I wrap gifts terribly — bags exist for people like me.
examples.zh: 我包礼物特别烂——礼品袋就是为我这种人发明的。

situation.en: Could you wrap this gift? It's for my mum.
situation.zh: 你在给朋友准备生日礼物，自嘲包装手艺。

examples.en: Ask for a gift receipt in case the size is wrong.
examples.zh: 要一张礼品小票，万一尺码不对还能换。

situation.en: I put the gift receipt in the box, so she can exchange it freely.
situation.zh: 你给朋友买衣服，结账时多要一样东西。

entries.zh: 礼品小票（凭它可退换货）

examples.en: Our office does Secret Santa with a fifty-yuan limit.
examples.zh: 我们办公室玩秘密圣诞礼物交换，上限五十元。

situation.en: I drew our manager for Secret Santa — no pressure at all.
situation.zh: 你向新同事解释办公室圣诞活动的玩法。

entries.zh: 秘密圣诞礼物交换（抽签互送）

examples.en: My New Year's resolution lasted until February, like everyone's.
examples.zh: 我的新年决心撑到了二月，跟所有人一样。

situation.en: This year my New Year's resolution is just one: sleep before midnight.
situation.zh: 跨年时大家聊新年目标，你自嘲一句。

examples.en: It's a potluck — bring one dish to share.
examples.zh: 这是百乐餐，每人带一道菜来分享。

situation.en: For the potluck, I'll bring dumplings — easy to share.
situation.zh: 你在给周末聚餐定形式，让每个人带菜。

entries.zh: 百乐餐（每人带一道菜的聚餐）
